scope: Official and UCI late only. Reuse exactly the earlier 32-per-batch seed-17 feedback IDs, chronology and source fit. One trajectory per arm. Service answers never enter training or choice before their authorized feedback release.
origin: All arms start at the identical official gas checkpoint. Preserve original Adam moments, epoch, normalizer, optimizer settings and checkpoint format.
fixed: Run the unchanged original checkpoint. Source-only and mixed-update arms each run exactly one original epoch per inter-batch interval, on exactly 2*number_source_fit rows. Draw with replacement using fixed SeedSequence([17,batch]); cycle evenly through present classes, sample uniformly within each. Source-only draws two source halves. Mixed draws one source half and one half from all past feedback. No first-batch training. Always deliver their respective latest checkpoints.
decision: Same candidate-generation budget as always-mixed: propose one continuation of its own previously deployed checkpoint on the same mixed rows. Use only the just-returned batch; deterministic hash rank of the 32 feedback ids splits them into two halves. Candidate trains only on the train half of every feedback batch (the fixed mixed control uses the identical training halves). The other half never trains. Switch only if candidate has strictly more correct predictions than incumbent on that most recent confirm half; ties keep incumbent. Record actual model parents, confirm wins/losses and service outputs. Under identical partitions, source-only and mixed arms have the same training row/step budget; frozen uses no training.
gate: To promote the selector for further independence testing require +0.01 pooled Macro-F1 over best of frozen, source-only and always-mixed on both streams and worst-class recall within 0.02 of the best-primary same-format control. Compare earlier observer as current product and return-logistic as the unrestricted reference. Score both positive and negative outcomes.
